newsitem.title: USA: Eastern files for 4.5 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Eastern files for 4.5 mln common shares.

text.p: Eastern Environmental Services Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to 4.5 million common shares.
The company has offered the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 675,000 additional common shares.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 21,061,497 common, Eastern said in the filing.
Net proceeds will be used to repay outstanding debt and working capital.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Sanders Morris Mundy, Van Kasper & Co and Pacific Growth Equities Inc, Eastern said.

Eastern, based in Mt. Laurel, N.J., is a non-hazardous solid waste management company specializing in the collection, transportation and disposal of residential, industrial, commercial and special waste.
